molecular_model_semantics.extinction: total Rayleigh volume scattering coefficient from Bucholtz-style molecular model
molecular_model_semantics.backscatter: angular volume scattering coefficient at 180 degrees using wavelength-dependent molecular depolarization/phase function

synthetic_test_statement: For a noiseless elastic forward model generated with the model-implied alpha_mol/beta_mol semantics, backward KFS using the matching molecular lidar ratio recovers the controlled aerosol profile more closely than KFS using the current fixed 8*pi/3 constant at both 355 and 532 nm.
unresolved_physics: Whether the relevant receiver/filter semantics correspond to total Rayleigh, Cabannes, or another effective detected molecular component.
The quantitative impact on representative real SPU retrievals under matched receiver semantics.
decision: R&D evidence only. Do not change productive molecular lidar-ratio semantics until receiver/filter physics and representative sensitivity are resolved; any productive change requires retrieval-method versioning.
